technology_name: FABRICATION OF PIEZORESISTIVE SENSORS USING PYROLYZED COCONUT FIBER AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional piezoresistive pressure and flex sensors depend on expensive metal foils or non-renewable synthetic polymer layers that elevate manufacturing overhead and ignore organic agricultural waste streams.
description: A green production method for engineering lightweight flexible piezoresistive sensors by subjecting natural coconut fiber strands to a customized, multi-temperature pyrolytic carbonization sequence, followed by embedding the conductive carbonized fibers cleanly inside flexible elastic polymer substrates.
applications: Wearable human motion tracking garments, biomedical pulse respiration wraps, industrial robot grip tactile sensors, and flexible electronic vehicle instrument control surfaces.
